_comments: Runs a submitted response's on-submit automations. The handler registers under HandlerKey
'Forms.RunAutomations' (BaseWorkHandler, forms-core-entities-server) on hosts of type MJWorker;
a host opts in through workQueue.subscriptions in its mj.config.cjs.
Delivery is at-least-once: retries back off with jitter between BackoffBaseSeconds and
BackoffMaxSeconds and dead-letter after MaxAttempts, so the handler must be idempotent. It
is, in the handler rather than in the schema: a (FormAutomationID, FormResponseID) pair is
NOT unique by design (an OnPartial step writes one run row per partial save), so idempotency
is event-scoped by exact identity: every run row carries the MessageID of the delivery that ran
it (FormAutomationRun.WorkQueueMessageID), a redelivery re-runs only the steps with no terminal
run (Succeeded, Failed, Skipped) carrying that id, on their open row, and a dead-lettered final
closes its open rows Failed (a replay reopens exactly those).
PartitionMode Ordered, keyed on the response id (forms-core-entities-server's
responseSubmittedRequest sets the PartitionKey): one response's messages are handled in publish
order, so a partial save's run never overtakes the final submit's, and a partial delivery that
finds its response already Complete is stale and runs nothing. Different responses still run in
parallel. Ordered needs a Database topic (forms.response-submitted is one).
A partial save never dead-letters (it closes its open rows as abandoned and completes), so it can
never block the response's final message; a retrying partial delays the final only by its backoff
(about 30 s over 5 attempts) plus LeaseSeconds for an attempt that hangs. A dead-lettered FINAL
blocks nothing after it (it is the response's last message); replaying it reopens and runs the
steps its dead letter closed. Because runs are matched by MessageID, no save's runs are ever
mistaken for another's (spec #303 section 12).

fields.Name: forms.run-automations
fields.Description: MJ Forms: runs the on-submit automations of each submitted response (HandlerKey Forms.RunAutomations).
